R3A-grouse-drive-0001.name: By Yalakom River
R3A-grouse-drive-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R3A-grouse-drive-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Yalakom River FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Road: Yalakom River FSR, 4.8 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
3 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
27 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: youth only: hunters under 18 (page footnote); New, printed green
MU 3-32 is not listed in the Region 3 sharp tailed grouse rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Resort Municipality of Whistler, about 135 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 99, Pemberton Portage Rd, Highline Rd, Anderson Lake Rd.
Park: 50.92656, -122.25521, pull off on Yalakom River FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Yalakom River FSR stretch, 4.8 km one way. About 96 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-32, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-27, closures 2026-10-16.
R3A-grouse-drive-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 3-32: about 7,373 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 1.90 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

R3A-moose-atv-0001.name: By Burkholder Creek
R3A-moose-atv-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R3A-moose-atv-0001.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 10 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 2.8 ha, right here.
Cutblock harvested 2017 (9 years old), right here: browse.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.notes: Bag 1; spike fork bulls: antlers must accompany the species licence (page footnote)

plan: Drive: from Resort Municipality of Whistler, about 133 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.93215, -122.31877, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 7.0 km on Burkholder by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 340 m NW, climb about 9 m.
Hunt: moose, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-32, Region 3. Season: moose spike fork bulls Oct 15 to Nov 15 (synopsis page 34, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-27, closures 2026-10-16.
R3A-moose-atv-0001.recDirections: Access is via the Yalakom Road off of highway 40 west of Lillooet. Although the site can be accessed with a two wheel drive vehicle, it is recommended that a 4x4 be used as the road can be slippery when wet, and in some places the hillside sloughs onto the road, so it may be necessary to drive over or around rocks.
R3A-moose-atv-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 3-32: about 676 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.17 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.3 km and about 9 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
